# Empowered Evocation (`features:evoker-empowered-evocation`)
**Class:** [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md) | **Subclass:** [Evoker](../subclasses/evoker.md) | **Level:** [Wizard 10](../levels/wizard-10.md)

Whenever you cast a Wizard spell from the Evocation school, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.
